title: Salvage
summary: SALV'AGE, noun [Latin salvus, salvo.] In commerce, a reward or recompense allowed by law for the saving of a ship, or goods from loss at sea, either by shipwreck or other means, or by enemies or pirat

inlines.v: SALV'AGE, noun [Latin salvus, salvo.] In commerce, a reward or recompense allowed by law for the saving of a ship, or goods from loss at sea, either by shipwreck or other means, or by enemies or pirates. SALV'AGE, for savage, not used. [See Savage.]
